estimand: P(Y | do(X)) transport formula on single-source selection diagrams inside Antecedent's sound sID subset
comparison: structural agreement: Antecedent certificate rule and formula kind match the frozen causaleffect 1.3.15 expression class; string identity with R's rendered expression is not required

reference.command: Rscript -e 'install.packages("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/causaleffect_1.3.15.tar.gz", repos=NULL, type="source"); library(igraph); library(causaleffect); d <- graph.formula(X -+ Y, S -+ Z, simplify=FALSE); d <- set.vertex.attribute(d, "description", which(V(d)$name=="S"), "S"); cat("direct_irrelevant_selection\t", as.character(transport(y="Y", x="X", D=d, expr=TRUE, simp=TRUE)), "\n", sep=""); d2 <- graph.formula(Z -+ Y, X -+ Y, S -+ Z, simplify=FALSE); d2 <- set.vertex.attribute(d2, "description", which(V(d2)$name=="S"), "S"); cat("standardize_exogenous_selection\t", as.character(transport(y="Y", x="X", D=d2, expr=TRUE, simp=TRUE)), "\n", sep="")'
reference.execution_note: The exact 1.3.15 CRAN tarball was executed unmodified as a black box on 2026-08-15. Only public-API inputs and formula strings are stored; no package source or tests were copied. Antecedent models selection targets on the causal ADMG rather than explicit S nodes; the diagrams above are the corresponding selection-target encoding of S->Z.
